title: Cross-Database Relationship Builder — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Automatically proposes links between records and verifies their compatibility. The builder scans databases for records that should connect, proposes the links, and verifies each one for compatibility before it is accepted. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success. "Boundless" means the capacity to extend this system, not a claim that its records or capabilities are already infinite. Record counts reported are actual populated counts; generated records are labeled "generated" and never mixed with sourced facts.
